notes:
{不可|ふか} is a Sino-Japanese word meaning "not permissible" or "impossible." It functions as both a noun and a na-adjective, and appears frequently in compound words and on signs.

USAGE AS PREFIX:
{不可|ふか} attaches to other Sino-Japanese words to form compounds meaning "cannot be ~":
- ⟦{不可能|ふかのう}→不可能：03144_fukanou⟧: impossible
- ⟦{不可欠|ふかけつ}→不可欠：07027_fukaketsu⟧: indispensable (cannot be lacking)
- ⟦{不可解|ふかかい}→不可解：07392_fukakai⟧: incomprehensible
- ⟦{不可避|ふかひ}→不可避：15524_fukahi⟧: unavoidable

SIGNS AND NOTICES:
Very common on signs in the pattern 〜{不可|ふか} (~ not allowed):
- ⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧{不可|ふか}: no photography
- ⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→持ち込み：08293_mochikomi⟧{不可|ふか}: no bringing in outside items
- ⟦{飲食|いんしょく}→飲食：03010_inshoku⟧{不可|ふか}: no eating or drinking

ACADEMIC GRADING:
In Japanese universities, {不可|ふか} is the failing grade (equivalent to F). The full scale is:
- ⟦{秀|しゅう}→秀：noentry⟧: A+, ⟦{優|ゆう}→優：00431_yuu⟧: A, ⟦{良|りょう}→良：noentry⟧: B, ⟦{可|か}→可：noentry⟧: C, {不可|ふか}: F
